items.subject: Denji
items.q: What happened to Denji during the War Devil arc, in order?
expect: After Yoru manages to emerge victorious, she attempts to turn Pochita into a weapon.
A guilt-ridden Denji reverts back to his human form and is sent falling upwards into the sky.
After transforming, Denji watches Yoru readying herself to kill more civilians and attempts to distract her with thoughts of food.
panel_line: Synopsis / Academy Saga / War Devil arc
After Yoru manages to emerge victorious, she attempts to turn Pochita into a weapon.

source.section: Synopsis / Academy Saga / War Devil arc

items.subject: Yoru
items.q: What happened to Yoru during the War Devil arc, in order?
expect: After forcibly giving Denji another kiss and questioning if he wants sex, Yoru makes a proposal that if he defeats the Death Devil, he can have sex with her.

After that short win, Yoru tears up, hesitating—questioning if she "forgot something", while off-guard, Falling Devil twists her arms by force manipulation but she manages to counter-attack and blow up Falling Devil's torso in to pieces.
After sacrificing the people of Oregon, Yoru slashes at Pochita with her blade, cleaving through the Chainsaw Devil and tearing apart the battlefield around them.
panel_line: Synopsis / Academy Saga / War Devil arc
After forcibly giving Denji another kiss and questioning if he wants sex, Yoru makes a proposal that if he defeats the Death Devil, he can have sex with her.

source.section: Synopsis / Academy Saga / War Devil arc

items.subject: Power
items.q: What happened to Power during the International Assassins arc, in order?
expect: Denji is happy to be seen on TV, while Makima is visibly infuriated, and comments on the prospect of Reze fulfilling her task and talks about how other countries are going to want to steal his heart.
Denji gets back up, and wonders if Power and the rest of the Devil Hunters are okay and tells Santa Claus she will get it for sending them to Hell.
Aki suggests she can drink Denji's blood after they handle the assassins.

items.subject: Fake Chainsaw Man
items.q: What happened to the Fake Chainsaw Man during the War Devil arc, in order?
expect: Although confused by how easy it was to take down "Death" herself, the imposter assures himself that he did the right thing.
Believing him to be another Pseudo-Chainsaw person, Yoru attempts to shoot his head off but the imposter deflects the gunshot right into a building above him.
Both Famine and the Fake Chainsaw Man attempt to convince Death to stop her madness, not wanting humanity to perish.

items.subject: Power
items.q: What was true of Power during the Control Devil arc?
expect: Denji and Power are left alone with half of Aki’s money in a new apartment, which he left to Denji, spending it on food to cope with Aki’s demise.
Denji and Power are seen playing video games and watching movies, before Denji goes out shopping for him and Power, after which he is met up by Makima, who invites him to her apartment.(Chapter 80)
Before disappearing, Power tells Denji that even if a devil dies, it'll always just be revived in Hell and be reincarnated in the surface world again.

items.subject: Kobeni Higashiyama
items.q: What was true of Kobeni Higashiyama during the Eternity Devil arc?
expect: After waiting over the course of three days for the battle between Denji and the Eternity Devil to be over, Kobeni sits in the corner in an exhausted state.(Chapter 19)
Aki questioned Himeno on the two newcomers and Himeno stated that Kobeni was pretty talented but also timid.(Chapter 14)
Inside the hotel, Kobeni follows the others while growing more nervous and muttering to herself.
panel_line: After waiting over the course of three days for the battle between Denji and the Eternity Devil to be over, Kobeni sits in the corner in an exhausted state.(Chapter 19)

items.subject: Denji
items.q: What was true of Denji during the Bat Devil arc?
expect: Denji also agrees with Aki on forgetting about the Bat Devil incident, and plays dumb to prevent Power from being executed.
Denji recovers in a hospital room and learns from Aki that Devil Hunters make contracts with devils, giving up parts of their bodies for power.
Denji initially isn’t interested in helping Power until being promised that he could touch her chest if he helps her out.(Chapter 5)

items.subject: Asa Mitaka
items.q: What does Asa Mitaka look like?
expect: Asa is a high school girl of average height.
She has dark blue eyes that are usually pitch dark, though the irises become much brighter in some situations.
Her hair is black and is sometimes colored with a brown tint.
panel_line: Asa is a high school girl of average height.

items.subject: Fumiko Mifune
items.q: What does Fumiko Mifune look like?
expect: Fumiko Mifune is a jolly young woman with short black hair.
Fumiko's eyes are unusually large with giant black irises, containing a red circle within them.
Her hair has a rather unkempt appearance though her bangs are tied into two ponytails at each side of her face.
panel_line: Fumiko Mifune is a jolly young woman with short black hair.

items.subject: Santa Claus
items.q: What does Santa Claus look like?
expect: Santa Claus’s main body is presumed to be a dark blue-haired, green eyed woman with a mole under her eye.
She also grew horns just like the Darkness Devil has and sharp teeth.
She has 40 eyes on her monstrous form in total, with 10 arms at day and even more arms at night.
panel_line: Santa Claus’s main body is presumed to be a dark blue-haired, green eyed woman with a mole under her eye.

items.subject: Locust Devil
items.q: What does the Locust Devil look like?
expect: The Locust Devil appears as a tall, broad-shouldered humanoid with a heavily segmented, insect-like body.
Four large, rigid wings resembling those of a locust extend from its back.

Its head is small relative to its torso and lacks distinct human features, instead resembling an insectoid mask, and a pair of long, thin antennae extend from its head, further emphasizing its insectoid nature.
panel_line: The Locust Devil appears as a tall, broad-shouldered humanoid with a heavily segmented, insect-like body.

items.subject: Denji
items.q: Why did Denji kill his father?
expect: At some point, Denji killed his father out of self-defense, as the latter was in a drunken aggressive state and he feared for his life.
Due to the sheer trauma gained from killing his own father, Denji began to repress this memory behind a psychological barrier, which took on the form of a closed door.(Chapter 82)
Seeing the injuries Pochita has suffered from, Denji decides to save him by offering him some of his blood.
panel_line: At some point, Denji killed his father out of self-defense, as the latter was in a drunken aggressive state and he feared for his life.

items.subject: Yoru
items.q: Why did Yoru come to Earth?
expect: This drove her to Earth where she would begin searching for a new body to possess in a last-ditch effort to save herself, as well as getting her revenge on Chainsaw Man.(Chapter 104)
Eventually Yoru got to the point where she was under real threat of being completely forgotten about which would mean permanent death for her.
Because of this, there hasn't been a single war since "the world war" which further diminished her strength.
panel_line: This drove her to Earth where she would begin searching for a new body to possess in a last-ditch effort to save herself, as well as getting her revenge on Chainsaw Man.(Chapter 104)

items.subject: Crambon
items.q: Why did Asa's caretaker kill Crambon?
expect: It turned out that the caretaker had lied to Asa and killed Crambon because she was jealous that Asa still had someone she considered family.(Chapter 123)
There, her caretaker, whose mother also (allegedly) died because of the Typhoon Devil, convinced her to give Crambon away to give him a happier home.
However, another orphan later told Asa that the children found Crambon drowned in a river.
panel_line: It turned out that the caretaker had lied to Asa and killed Crambon because she was jealous that Asa still had someone she considered family.(Chapter 123)

items.subject: Gun Devil
items.q: Why has the worldwide fear of guns increased?
expect: Due to heavy media coverage of gun crimes in every country, worldwide fear of guns has increased drastically.(Chapter 13)
This led to an increase in gun use during crimes and civil revolts.
An international law has been prepared to strictly control the manufacturing of arms in every country to lower the fear of guns.(Chapter 73)
panel_line: Due to heavy media coverage of gun crimes in every country, worldwide fear of guns has increased drastically.(Chapter 13)

items.subject: Makima
items.q: Why did Makima capture the Angel Devil?
expect: Following this incident, Makima had the Angel Devil captured and enlisted him as a member of Public Safety.(Chapter 42)

While the Angel Devil initially refused as it would mean siphoning the lifespan of others, Makima ordered him to do so and forced him to unconsciously siphon the lives of everyone within his village.(Chapter 74)
At another point in time, Makima traveled to a coastal village and encountered the Angel Devil, and requested that he show her his power.
panel_line: Following this incident, Makima had the Angel Devil captured and enlisted him as a member of Public Safety.(Chapter 42)

items.subject: Denji
items.q: What is Denji's personality like?
expect: Denji is both brash and naïve as a result of being unable to have a formal education and socialize due to living in severe poverty, making him generally crass and vulgar.
Denji also harbors a fear that his seeming lack of empathy and attachment after his transformation is a sign that he is losing his sense of humanity.
Due to his desire to have intercourse with a woman, he generally treats women with more kindness and respect than men.
panel_line: Denji is both brash and naïve as a result of being unable to have a formal education and socialize due to living in severe poverty, making him generally crass and vulgar.

items.subject: Asa Mitaka
items.q: What is Asa Mitaka's personality like?
expect: Asa is a quiet and unsociable girl, who dislikes her classmates, frequently wishing they would drop dead and spurning any offers of friendship.(Chapter 98)
Asa is fairly altruistic, putting herself in harm's way to save others even when she is afraid.
Asa later admits to herself that her mean-spirited attitude towards her peers was a result of jealousy and a lack of belonging.
panel_line: Asa is a quiet and unsociable girl, who dislikes her classmates, frequently wishing they would drop dead and spurning any offers of friendship.(Chapter 98)

items.subject: Power
items.q: What is Power's personality like?
expect: Power is an insatiable glutton, eating all of the stored food that the team needed in order to survive the Eternity Devil's trap and hoarding food for herself at the Division 4's newbie welcoming party.(Chapter 17)(Chapter 20)

Power is a compulsive habitual liar; after getting in trouble with Makima for killing a Devil when she wasn't supposed to, Power immediately blamed Denji and claimed he told her to kill it.(Chapter 5)
Power is also rude, unkempt, and feels as though those around her should clean up after her.
panel_line: Power is an insatiable glutton, eating all of the stored food that the team needed in order to survive the Eternity Devil's trap and hoarding food for herself at the Division 4's newbie welcoming party.(Chapter 17)(Chapter 20)

items.subject: Fami
items.q: What is Fami's personality like?
expect: Befitting her status as the Famine Devil, Fami is also a major glutton, frequently ordering inhuman levels of food to consume in a single setting and sometimes eating it without any utensils, seen when she messily eats a giant plate of spaghetti with her bare hands and no thought of the mess on her face from the marinara sauce.(Chapter 122)(Chapter 163)
Fami also calls the Guillotine Devil by an affectionate nickname.
Fami also seems affectionate towards Yoru, saying that she would do anything for her "little sister".(Chapter 108)
panel_line: Befitting her status as the Famine Devil, Fami is also a major glutton, frequently ordering inhuman levels of food to consume in a single setting and sometimes eating it without any utensils, seen when she messily eats a giant plate of spaghetti with her bare hands and no thought of the mess on her face from the marinara sauce.(Chapter 122)(Chapter 163)
